fields.captured_at: mtime of entity-id.txt in this directory
fields.exe_sha256: binary measured by the pin-provenance refresh; T4 re-ran the demo frame with it and reproduced these BMPs byte-for-byte
fields.exe_sha256_at_capture: value the capture log itself recorded; historical, asserted by nothing
fields.git_head: t91 HEAD when the pin was re-verified (see read_at)
fields.native_tree_sha256: sha256 of 'git ls-tree -r HEAD -- native' output at git_head, so a reader can tell which native/ tree the re-verification ran against
fields.expected_bmp_sha256: asserted against the files by pin-provenance-check.sh
fields.identity: the class body the identity frame was judged on

notes: exe_sha256 is the binary that re-produced these pins at read_at, not the binary of the original capture; git_head/native_tree_sha256 are measured at the same moment. The pin bytes themselves are unchanged since the 2026-11-07 re-pin.
